Subject: RDW DPA redlines + SCCs & UK IDTA notes

Emma / Laura — attaching our proposed redlines and a short note on approach. Key points we tracked for your legal team to review:

1) SCCs: We adopted the European Commission standard clauses where required and added a short binding mechanism annex. We flagged areas where Finex had proposed more prescriptive logging/retention obligations.

2) UK IDTA: We've prepared a concise addendum template that sits alongside the DPA (we propose an "IDTA Addendum - UK" annex). The addendum preserves the DPA's main obligations while applying UK provisions.

3) Subprocessors: We include a process for notification and a 10-day review window before new subprocessors are onboarded. We are happy to provide a full export of current subprocessors (CSV) and can also provide SOC/Security attestations on request for specific providers.

4) Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA): Rather than a full public TIA document, we provide a redacted summary for procurement (controls, legal basis, risk mitigations, and residual risk). If Finex requires the full internal assessment, we can arrange an NDA-limited exchange.

5) Execution: We can complete execution via DocuSign or AdobeSign. Please confirm signer names and if Finex requires witness signatures.

Action items for Finex: review attached redlines and the IDTA addendum; confirm signing platform and desired signatories; let us know if you need copies of SOC2 or KMS/HSM attestations.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
